contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payments-wero-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-wero-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-wero.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/wero`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7, 2026 capture at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/wero describes standalone Wero as EUR authenticated bank transfer for buyers in Belgium, France, Germany, Luxembourg and the Netherlands, distinct from 30 listed business-account countries (new raw lines 9-47 and 53-95). A customer connects a bank account to Wero and selects it at checkout. Stripe redirects to Wero's authentication page, the customer scans the QR and approves in the Wero app, and the payment typically processes in under ten seconds before return (new raw lines 114-124). Return is not independently verified success or payout. The overview says standard payout timing and manual capture support but gives no capture state sequence. A dated acceptance guide separately describes Intent status verification and a one-hour authentication expiry. Compared with May 5 (old raw lines 12-46 and 94-125), November expands buyer geography and changes manual capture to Yes, adds business restrictions and states 730 days for refunds. source-stripe-wero.md still presents Germany-only, no manual capture and an overstated interest-form prerequisite.
reviewed_answers.Q2: The substantive changes at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/wero include the five-country buyer list, standalone Wero manual capture from No to Yes, the explicit 730-day refund cutoff and added category restrictions. The interest-form invitation is removed while Dashboard activation instructions remain (old raw lines 12-46, 94-113 and 119-125; new raw lines 13-47, 95-112 and 118-143). Heading formatting and Elements quickstart destination are presentational or navigational. Preserve May Germany-only buyers separately from 30 business locations, the literal two-year refund wording, no recurring/disputes and the typical rather than guaranteed ten-second timing. The November payments overview still labels Wero public preview, while iDEAL | Wero is a separate identity with its own migration instruction and an unsupported manual-capture cell. The overlapping Netherlands buyer geography does not erase that distinction. Keep separate acceptance navigation and retain root index line 7, Stripe index lines 289 and 757 and Wero concept lines 52-53, adding a source backlink in source-stripe-wero.md and retaining both factual captures.
